trechos.trecho: SLAVE WAGE As many other tutors have already mentioned, the pay is absolutely abysmal. Cambly advertises that tutors can earn UP TO $10.20 USD per hour
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre salário muito baixo para tutores

trechos.trecho: This company is the worst! It has a toxic work environment, unfair low pay, and engages in unfair business practices.
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre ambiente de trabalho tóxico e remuneração injusta

trechos.trecho: The pay. It's unbelievable how low it is! Especially with the current conditions we are living in. Cambly also takes on average 2/3 of what the students pay.
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre retirada excessiva de comissão pela plataforma

trechos.trecho: Signed up one week ago, Cambly charged my credit card already but never can take a class. Called them but only get a machine answer
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre cobrança sem acesso ao serviço e atendimento deficiente

trechos.trecho: Open English are a bunch of crooks; they lie to people just to get customers. They call incessantly, begging you to sign up
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre mentiras em vendas e assédio por chamadas telefônicas

trechos.trecho: They have an outdated platform, and there are unexpected charges that are not disclosed at the time of purchase. On top of that...you need to pay extra
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre plataforma desatualizada e cobranças extras não informadas

trechos.trecho: They also make up to eight intrusive calls every day, pressuring me to purchase additional products and extra classes.
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre assédio telefônico para venda de produtos adicionais

trechos.trecho: My experience was not good; it did not meet my expectations.
trechos.contexto: Reclamação sobre experiência não atender expectativas (1 estrela)
